name: PDL fade

story.template: {symbol} broke below PDL {line:,.2f} at {break_at}, fell to {run_px:,.2f} ({run_pct:+.1f} %), first 5m close back above at {at}.

note: Stage 2 of the PD fade (design 1 Nov 2026): the first 5m close back above yesterday's low after a flush of at least 1 % below it, price > 1000, fired 09:20-11:00 only. Long at the close, stop = the day's low (the flush's extreme), target = the previous close. One per stock per day (cooldown 400 min); min_rr 0 because the median R:R is 1:0.3 by design. Backtest 20 sessions (1-30 Oct 2026, 213 stocks), before 11:00 with a 1 % run: 4 fires/day, target first 83 %, median R:R 1:0.3, +0.17 R per trade. All day with a 0.3 % run was 22/day, 56 %, 1:0.9, -0.02 R, hence the window and the deeper run.
